description: Create a Tables application (context), or change one when contextId is given. Passing nodes replaces its tables and views. Share it with share_table and contextId.

contextId.description: Application to change. Omit to create one

iconName.description: Material Design icon name bundled with Tables, e.g. 'briefcase'. Default 'apps'

nodes.description: The tables and views the application shows, one of tableId and viewId each

permissions.description: What users of the application may do here. Default: read only

name: save_table_context
title: Save Table Application
